# Compass BI

> Data warehouse, dashboards, alerts and AI agents for businesses running on Priority ERP or NetSuite. A complete BI infrastructure as a monthly service - with no in-house BI team and no infrastructure investment.

An official Priority technology partner since 2021.
20+ years of BI expertise.
Connect in one day. Live within weeks.

## Pages

- [Home page](https://compassbi.co.il/en/): Compass BI - Analytics for Priority and NetSuite
- [Compass Control](https://compassbi.co.il/en/control/): Compass Control checks your data against rules agreed with you, and hands every exception to its owner with a recommended action.
- [AI](https://compassbi.co.il/en/ai/): Ask in plain language and get an answer from your business's data model, with an agent for the team or personal exploration in the AI tool of your choice. Connect in one day, live within weeks.

## Modules

- [Dashboards for Plants on Priority - Production, Inventory, Warehouse](https://compassbi.co.il/en/manufacturing/): One data warehouse on top of Priority: plan against actual for every machine, inventory and procurement recommendations, warehouse and sales. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [Dashboards for Inventory and Warehouse on Priority](https://compassbi.co.il/en/logistics/): One data warehouse on top of Priority: inventory and procurement recommendations, and what is still open in the warehouse. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [WMS and Warehouse Management Dashboard on Priority](https://compassbi.co.il/en/wms/): What is still open in receiving and picking, by distribution line and station, alongside inventory and procurement recommendations. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [Sales and Collections Dashboards on Priority](https://compassbi.co.il/en/sales/): One data warehouse on top of Priority: what was sold, what it earned and who has paid, for every customer and every salesperson. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [Budget Control and P&L Dashboards on Priority](https://compassbi.co.il/en/finance/): Budget against actual by line, and profitability by profit center, on one data warehouse. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [Service and Support Dashboard: Calls, Faults and Handling Time](https://compassbi.co.il/en/service/): The life of every call, handling time by team, customer and fault type, and open faults by waiting time. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [Labor Utilization and Billable Hours Dashboard](https://compassbi.co.il/en/utilization/): The billable-hours share for every employee and team, and the gap against standard. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
- [Lead Tracking and Sales Dashboard](https://compassbi.co.il/en/leads/): Where inquiries come from, what became of them and which source closes deals, alongside sales and collections. Connect in one day, live within weeks.
